questions.gold_sql: SELECT substr(order_date,1,7), SUM(revenue-cost) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-05-01' AND order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY substr(order_date,1,7) ORDER BY 1

questions.natural_language_question: Which category contributed most to the July revenue decline?
questions.gold_sql: WITH base AS (SELECT products.category c, SUM(revenue) v FROM orders JOIN products ON orders.product_id=products.product_id WHERE order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c), tgt AS (SELECT products.category c, SUM(revenue) v FROM orders JOIN products ON orders.product_id=products.product_id WHERE order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND order_date < '2026-08-01' GROUP BY c) SELECT COALESCE(base.c, tgt.c), base.v, tgt.v, COALESCE(tgt.v,0) - COALESCE(base.v,0) AS delta FROM base LEFT JOIN tgt ON base.c=tgt.c ORDER BY delta ASC
